error.flow_range: The minimum flow temperature has to be lower than the maximum.

user.title: New HeatCast controller
user.description:
HeatCast calculates the flow temperature for your boiler from the outdoor temperature, the weather forecast and the temperature in your rooms.

Pick the heat emitters on the circuit. This only sets starting values for the heating curve; every value can be changed later.

boiler.title: Boiler
boiler.description:
Where HeatCast sends the flow temperature. With EMS-ESP this is usually `number.boiler_selflowtemp` and `switch.boiler_heatingoff`.

Nothing is sent until you turn on **Boiler control**. Until then HeatCast only calculates, so you can compare it with your current setup first.

data_description.flow_entity: Number entity the boiler reads the requested flow temperature from. It is refreshed every 30 seconds.
data_description.block_entity: Optional. Turned on when there is no heating demand, off otherwise.
data_description.idle_flow: Sent instead when there is no heating demand and no heating off switch is set.
data_description.flame_sensor: Optional, used to show when the boiler is actually heating.

climate.title: Weather
climate.description: The outdoor sensor drives the heating curve. A weather service with an hourly forecast lets HeatCast react to coming temperature changes, sun and wind before the house feels them.

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Preferably the boiler's own outdoor sensor.
data_description.weather: Optional. Needs a weather service with an hourly forecast, such as Met.no.
data_description.schedule: Optional. Outside the schedule the eco setback applies. Without a schedule it never applies.

curve.title: Heating curve
curve.description: The curve gives the flow temperature for a room temperature of 20 °C at a given outdoor temperature. Room sensors correct it later by a few kelvin.

data.design_temp: Flow temperature at the coldest day

data_description.curve_exponent: 1.0 is a straight line. Underfloor heating about 1.1, radiators about 1.3.
data_description.curve_offset: Moves the whole curve up or down.
data_description.summer_temp: Heating stops when the outdoor temperature, with the forecast taken into account, is above this value.

curve_check.title: Check the curve

room.title: Room
room.description: Each room has a temperature sensor and a weight. The controller keeps the weighted average of all rooms at their targets; a room with weight 0 is only shown. The room temperature is set later on its thermostat.

data_description.weight: How much the room counts, 0 to 1.
data_description.valve: Optional thermostatic radiator valve. HeatCast sets it to the room target every 5 minutes while boiler control is on.
data_description.valve_temperature: Optional number entity of the valve for an external temperature. HeatCast writes the room sensor value to it.

reconfigure.title: Boiler and weather
reconfigure.description: Change the entities HeatCast reads and writes. Curve and controller values are changed on the device page.

options.mixed: Underfloor and radiators on one circuit

init.title: HeatCast settings
init.description:
Individual room temperatures add a thermostat to every room and a **Room sync** switch. With a single heating circuit and no radiator valves the controller finds a weighted compromise, so not every room will reach its own temperature.

HeatCast reports problems on the Repairs page and with its **Problem** sensor. Pick a notify service to get them on your phone as well.

data_description.notify_service: Optional, for example mobile_app_your_phone. A message is sent when a problem starts and when it is resolved.

setpoint_not_accepted.title: {name}: boiler does not accept the flow setpoint
setpoint_not_accepted.description:
HeatCast writes {written_flow} °C, the boiler reported {boiler_flow} °C for 3 minutes. Check the boiler and its connection, for example EMS-ESP. If in doubt, turn off **Boiler control**; the boiler then runs on its own curve.

This issue disappears by itself once the boiler follows the setpoint again.

room_sensors_lost.title: {name}: room sensors lost
room_sensors_lost.description:
Less than half of the room weight has had a valid temperature for 15 minutes. The flow temperature follows the heating curve alone until the sensors are back.

This issue disappears by itself once the sensors report again.

outdoor_lost.title: {name}: outdoor temperature lost
outdoor_lost.description:
The outdoor sensor has had no value for 15 minutes. HeatCast keeps working with the last damped outdoor temperature, which no longer follows the weather.

This issue disappears by itself once the sensor reports again.

flow_too_high.title: {name}: flow temperature too high
flow_too_high.description:
The measured flow temperature was {measured_flow} °C for 10 minutes, more than 10 K above the maximum flow temperature, outside hot water heating. Check the boiler and the mixing valve.

This issue disappears by itself once the flow temperature drops.
